desc: Key Applications: Virtualization, Software-defined Storage, AI Inference and Machine Learning, Cloud ComputingEnterprise Server
Key Features: Dual Socket E (LGA-4677) 5th/4th Gen Intel® Xeon® Scalable processors
32 DIMM slots supporting up to 8TB of memory; RDIMMs up to DDR5-5600
Optional PCIe slot configurations up to 8 PCIe 5.0 x8 or 4 PCIe 5.0 x16 slots with support for double-width GPU/Accelerator cards
Flexible networking options with up to 2 AIOM networking slots (OCP NIC 3.0 compatible)
12x 3.5"/2.5" hot-swap NVMe/SATA/SAS drive bays
2x internal M.2 NVMe/SATA drive slots
Optional RAID support via storage add-on card
4 heavy duty hot-swap fans with optimal fan speed control

SFT-AUTOMATION-NODE.d: SuperCloud Automation Center (SCAC) is a workflow platform automating firmware, OS, and Kubernetes/AI stack deployment and GPU diagnostics at scale. For data centers and edge sites, with both PXE and non-PXE provisioning. Perpetual single-node license.

SFT-SDDC-SINGLE.d: SuperCloud Composer (SCC) for Rack Scale Management for Air Cooled Server, security and service integrated features like attestation, call-home. Node License, Up to Gen14, 3 YEARS support

SFT-AICON-SUP-STD-3Y.d: SuperCloud Developer Console (SDX) Standard Support: M-F 9-5, 3 years, per node. Add-on for SDX license customers.

SFT-CLD-DIR-SUP-STD-3Y.d: SuperCloud Director (SCD) Standard Support: M-F 9-5, 3 years, per node. Add-on for SCD license customers.

SFT-DCMS-SINGLE.d: System Management capabilities for data centers, Node License, Up to Gen14, 3 YEARS support

SFT-CLD-DIR-NODE-3Y.d: SuperCloud Director (SCD) is a Bare Metal as a Service platform for multi-tenant AI clouds. For neoclouds, CSPs, and large enterprises, with per-tenant compute and Ethernet/InfiniBand network isolation enforced on NVIDIA BlueField DPUs (NICo). 3-year subscription, per node.

SFT-AICON-NODE-3Y.d: SuperCloud Developer Console (SDX) is a GPUaaS platform with project-based access and quotas for sharing GPUs across teams. For neoclouds and CSPs offering GPU workspaces, VMs, and Token as a Service to end users. 3-year subscription, per node.

SFT-AUTOMATION-SUP-STD-3.d: SuperCloud Automation Center (SCAC) Standard Support: M-F 9-5, 3 years, per node. Add-on for SCAC license customers.
